messages:
Anya: Quick request — need a set of benchmark graphics and a 1-slide diagram for next Tues webinar. Core asks: 3 hero tiles (social-sized), a 1200x600 hero for the webinar page, and a single-slide "bench matrix" that shows latency vs cost tradeoffs. Brand safe, accessible colors, and a lightweight alt-text doc. Can we get first drafts by EOD Fri?
Matt: Got it. Any existing art or figma file to iterate from? also are we doing animated gifs or static?
Anya: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/bench-templates — I added a new page "Mar 2026 webinar". Static for launch + one GIF micro-variant (800x800) for social.
Sasha: Copy for the tiles — will drop short headlines here by tomorrow morning. Also: prefer numbers over text in the bench matrix (easier scan).
Oliver: Brand note — avoid using the secondary neon gradient for prints; use the 2 approved brand palettes. Also ensure logo lockup has 24px clearspace and we use the dark/white reversible mark depending on background.
Matt: Cool. Quick accessibility checklist I want to run against assets:
```
- Contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text
- Headline contrast >= 3:1 allowed if decorative
- Alt text: 1 sentence + 2 bullets for context
- SVGs: text-as-text (no outline) for screen readers
- Colorblind test: avoid red/green sole encoding
```
Will build templates with editable text layers.
design-bot: Figma page updated: "Mar 2026 webinar" (3 tiles + hero + bench slide). Version: v4. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/bench-templates?node-id=240%3A12
Matt: Uploading a compressed spec pack to the figma comments with exact export sizes and naming convention. Example filename pattern:
```
redwood_bench_tile_social_1200x1200_v1.png
redwood_webinar_hero_1200x600_v1.png
redwood_bench_matrix_slide_16x9_v1.pdf
```
Sasha: For the tile headlines: "Serving wins: latency vs cost", "Optimize inference economics", "Predictable latency for products" — will add alt-text suggestions in the doc.
Oliver: Legal flag — please include a short attribution line for any 3rd-party benchmarks used. If we're using internal numbers label them as "Redwood internal benchmark, Mar 2026".
Anya: Good call. Legal — can you review the slide copy + the attribution line by Mon noon?
Legal: Acknowledged. We'll do a quick sweep Monday morning; if any third-party logos appear we'll need clearance or use plain text attribution. Expect note by 12:00 PT Mon.
Matt: One question on the bench matrix: do we want multiple model curves (e.g., small/medium/large) or a single aggregated curve?
Anya: Let's include 3 faint curves (small/med/large) plus a bold recommended-config line. Keep legend minimal. Sasha will provide the labels.
Sasha: Labels: Small = fast/low-cost, Medium = balanced, Large = high-quality. I will inline the short descriptions in the figma notes.
Matt: Fine — I'll hand off first static drafts by Fri EOD. GIF variant tbd if time; otherwise next sprint.
Anya: Thank you team — priority: web hero + bench slide first, then tiles. Ping if blockers. :rocket:
